@graph.description: The Northern Illinois Transit Authority (NITA) is proud to provide reduced fares to low income transit riders. The program, which started in 2024, expanded regionwide in 2026 and allows residents of the NITA region who qualify for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) or Illinois Department of Human Services' FRESH Program to take CTA, Metra, or Pace at a reduced price. Applications are available at  GetAccess.org .   The Access Program is an expansion of NITA's  Ride Free and Reduced Fare  programs, which will continue to be available to older adults and individuals with disabilities.
